📢 LEADERSHIP CAREER OPPORTUNITIES AT ADICHUNCHANAGIRI UNIVERSITY (ACU)
Adichunchanagiri University invites applications from accomplished academicians and experienced academic leaders for the following positions:

🔹 Principal – Engineering College
🔹 Principal – Pharmacy College
🔹 Principal – Natural Sciences College

Desired Profile:
- Ph.D. in the relevant discipline.
- Qualifications and experience as per applicable regulatory norms (AICTE / PCI / other statutory requirements, as applicable).
- Strong academic and administrative leadership experience.
- Proven capabilities in institutional development, faculty management, research, accreditation and regulatory compliance.

Location: BG Nagara - near Bellur Cross

Interested candidates may share their updated CV at:

📧 Email: directorhr@acu.edu.in or  **Whatsapp:** : 8903358382
Interviews will be scheduled by 11th & 12th November

We welcome accomplished academic professionals who are passionate about building institutions, nurturing talent and driving academic excellence.

Please share this opportunity with suitable and deserving academic leaders within your professional network.

Dexian India is Hiring! Join Our Talent Acquisition Team!
We’re expanding our team and looking for passionate, driven, and result-oriented Technical Recruiters to join us!

If you love connecting great talent with exciting opportunities, have a strong understanding of the tech hiring landscape, and can identify talent for niche and challenging technical requirements, we’d love to hear from you!
📍 Location: Bangalore
💼 Experience: 1-3 years

What we’re looking for:
✅ Experience in end-to-end technical recruitment.
✅Strong understanding of IT roles, technologies, and skill sets.
✅Ability to understand and work on niche and specialized technical requirements.
✅Expertise in sourcing and identifying hard-to-find talent across different technologies.
✅Hands-on experience with candidate screening, engagement, and stakeholder management.
✅Strong networking skills and the ability to build quality talent pipelines.
✅A passion for delivering an excellent candidate experience.

📩 Interested candidates can  share your resumes with me at masiraayman.syeda@dexian.com

TiE Mysuru is looking for a dynamic leader to drive the growth of the startup ecosystem through Vistara.

We’re inviting applications for the position of Director – Vistara Startup Ecosystem, a full-time opportunity to work closely with startups, mentors, investors and industry partners to build meaningful connections and create opportunities for entrepreneurial growth.

If you bring experience in the startup ecosystem, incubation, acceleration or venture building, along with strong networking and execution skills, this could be your opportunity to make an impact.

Compensation: ₹12 LPA + performance bonus up to ₹1.2 LPA.

Apply now: ed@mysuru.tie.org
